hints.title: The rising
hints.text: The rising decides whether you become a Shaper or a Hush.

hints.title: The Lit
hints.text: Shapers are called the Lit on the street.

hints.title: The Hush
hints.text: The Hush are also called the Dim, an insult.

hints.title: One element
hints.text: The rising gives each Shaper an element and a nation.

hints.title: The search
hints.text: Trapped inside ELEMENTS, you begin the search for the Allborn with a rumour.

hints.title: The Prism
hints.text: The Allborn is also known as the Prism.

hints.title: Four elements
hints.text: People say the Allborn commands all four elements.

hints.title: A way home
hints.text: People say only the Allborn can open a way out.

hints.title: The Hush at work
hints.text: Only the Hush can craft from raw materials.

hints.title: The Vakna
hints.text: A Hush who awakens to an element is called a Vakna.

hints.title: Two crafts
hints.text: Vakna keep their crafting skills when they gain an element.

hints.title: IGNIS
hints.text: IGNIS is a volcanic forge city of black stone and ember-lit streets.

hints.title: AQUES
hints.text: Canals run between the stilt houses of AQUES’s river delta.

hints.title: TERRA
hints.text: TERRA is a canyon fortress cut into ochre cliffs.

hints.title: AURA
hints.text: AURA stands on high cliffs, with wind towers and rope bridges.

hints.title: Crimson
hints.text: Crimson is the colour of IGNIS.

hints.title: Azure
hints.text: Azure is the colour of AQUES.

hints.title: Ochre
hints.text: Ochre is the colour of TERRA.

hints.title: Pale white
hints.text: Pale white is the colour of AURA.

hints.title: The forge nation
hints.text: IGNIS is at war with every other nation.

hints.title: The canyon nation
hints.text: TERRA is the richest nation after Chromara.

hints.title: The healers
hints.text: People travel to AQUES to recover and be healed.

hints.title: The high cliffs
hints.text: AURA is peaceable toward every nation.

hints.title: Going to town
hints.text: When people talk about going to town, they mean Chromara.

hints.title: Younglings
hints.text: Newcomers are treated as younglings who have just come of age.

hints.title: Four rulers
hints.text: Each nation has its own ruler.

hints.title: The Edict
hints.text: The Edict is the law that banished the old names of the elements.

hints.title: The seat
hints.text: Whoever holds the seat of the Edict is the Lord.

hints.title: The vanished Lord
hints.text: The previous Lord vanished before the current Lord took the seat.

hints.title: Chromara
hints.text: Chromara is the great city at the centre of the world.

hints.title: The treasury
hints.text: The treasury and the main market are in Chromara.

hints.title: The Sentries
hints.text: The Sentries enforce the Edict.

hints.title: The border forts
hints.text: The Lord’s army holds border forts in every nation.

hints.title: Nation markets
hints.text: Every nation has markets of its own.

hints.title: Deserters
hints.text: Deserters from the Lord’s army roam the roads between nations.

hints.title: Street gangs
hints.text: Robbers and miscreants gather in Chromara’s back streets.

hints.title: Wild beasts
hints.text: Monsters take the shape of local beasts touched by elemental power.

hints.title: Nation bosses
hints.text: Each nation’s boss guards a rumour held by its master.

hints.title: The unseen Lord
hints.text: The unseen Lord rules through the Sentries and the Edict.

hints.title: The nameless boss
hints.text: The Lord banned the world boss’s name too.

hints.title: Near Chromara
hints.text: The world boss rises near Chromara and changes element every few days.

hints.title: One shared fight
hints.text: Every player fighting the world boss chips away at one shared health bar.

hints.title: After the fall
hints.text: The world boss returns stronger after it falls.

hints.title: The sleeping boss
hints.text: While the world boss sleeps, its next element strengthens monsters of that element.

hints.title: The Lord’s coin
hints.text: CHROMA carries an ear stamped on its face.

hints.title: Earned in play
hints.text: CHROMA is earned by playing and cannot be bought with money or cashed out.

hints.title: Sealed notes
hints.text: Counting houses exchange deposited coin for sealed notes honoured by other counting houses.

hints.title: Three houses
hints.text: Chromara has three counting houses and one bank.

hints.title: Two houses
hints.text: Each nation has two counting houses.

hints.title: The Dim traders
hints.text: Most trade runs through the Dim.

hints.title: Before the Edict
hints.text: Dungeon ruins still bear carvings of the elements’ old names.

hints.title: The Raid Hall
hints.text: The Dim run the Raid Hall in Chromara and its nation branches.

hints.title: Hired fighters
hints.text: NPC fighters are hired for CHROMA and paid per run.

hints.title: After dark
hints.text: Robbers become bolder at night, and some monsters appear only after dark.

hints.title: A remembered favour
hints.text: Favours improve an NPC’s opinion of you because they remember how you treat them.

hints.title: Beginners
hints.text: Beginners wear commoner’s rags until they buy or earn nation garb.

hints.title: Army uniform
hints.text: The Lord’s soldiers and the Sentries wear a uniform marked with the ear seal.

hints.title: One rising
hints.text: Each account gets one rising, with no way to buy another roll.

hints.title: The far roads
hints.text: The Sentries patrol near Chromara, leaving the far roads lawless.

hints.title: The guild hall
hints.text: Guilds and clans share a vault and can build a hall on their land.

hints.title: The master’s lead
hints.text: The first master gives a newcomer one fight, mentions the Allborn and points them to town.

hints.title: Dungeon keys
hints.text: Only the Dim can craft the keys needed for dungeon runs.

hints.title: The healer’s work
hints.text: AQUES treats lasting injuries and gear wear faster and cheaper than anywhere else.

hints.title: Rival nations
hints.text: Travellers from an enemy nation face higher prices and close attention from guards.

hints.title: Move
hints.text: Walk through Sindr to approach people or collect dropped loot.

hints.title: Look around
hints.text: Turn the camera to check the street around you.

hints.title: Run
hints.text: Hold Run while moving to run.

hints.title: Jump
hints.text: Jump once, then tap again in the air to rise higher.

hints.title: Strike
hints.text: Use Strike for a light attack in your current fighting style.

hints.title: Heavy strike
hints.text: Use Heavy strike for your style’s heavy attack.

hints.title: Raise your guard
hints.text: Hold Guard to block an incoming blow.

hints.title: Parry
hints.text: Raise your guard just as a blow lands to parry it.

hints.title: Dodge
hints.text: Dodge to move out of a blow’s path.

hints.title: Lock on
hints.text: Lock onto a foe to keep the camera on your target.

hints.title: Draw a weapon
hints.text: Draw your weapon to switch to weapon attacks.

hints.title: Use your hands
hints.text: Switch to hands for bare-handed strikes.

hints.title: Use your legs
hints.text: Switch to legs to fight with kicks.

hints.title: Change stance
hints.text: Switch between your weapon and your hands.

hints.title: Bending
hints.text: Switch bending on or off to choose whether to fight with it.

hints.title: Rise
hints.text: Use Rise for your element’s launching move.

hints.title: Ground strike
hints.text: Use Ground for your element’s ground move when no interaction is offered.

hints.title: Element move
hints.text: Your bending move’s effect depends on your element.

hints.title: Ultimate
hints.text: Use your element’s ultimate once tier five allows it.

hints.title: Shard spark
hints.text: A Hush can spend a shard to throw a small elemental spark.

hints.title: Technique
hints.text: Use Technique for your element’s special technique.

hints.title: Interact
hints.text: Use Interact when an offer appears near a stall or a person.

hints.title: A challenge
hints.text: Use Challenge to call a fighter into a brawl.

hints.title: Your satchel
hints.text: Open your satchel to see what you carry.

hints.title: Help and controls
hints.text: Open the menu to read the controls.

hints.title: Collect the drop
hints.text: Walk over the loot where an enemy died to collect it.

hints.title: Carried coin
hints.text: Villains mostly drop the CHROMA they carried.

hints.title: Bank before travel
hints.text: Deposit coin at a counting house before taking a full pack onto the road.

hints.title: Either counting house
hints.text: A sealed note from one counting house is honoured at the other.

hints.title: Marked players
hints.text: Counting houses refuse withdrawals while you have a red flag or bounty.

hints.title: On the ground
hints.text: If you die in the world, the materials you carried stay where you fell.

hints.title: The shrine
hints.text: After dying in the world, you wake at your nation’s shrine.

hints.title: A full pack
hints.text: Robbers target players who carry too much.

hints.title: Read the price
hints.text: Read a merchant’s reason on a price before trading.

hints.title: Shop stock
hints.text: A merchant’s stock affects the price they offer.

hints.title: The keeper’s purse
hints.text: Each merchant pays for what you sell from their own purse.

hints.title: Closed after dark
hints.text: Return to Sindr’s stalls when they open after the night closure.

hints.title: A closed window
hints.text: A trade is refused after dark even if you opened the shop window earlier.

hints.title: The notice board
hints.text: The board outside the market lists open bounties and their rewards.

hints.title: Your standing
hints.text: Read the notice board to check your red flags and bounty.

hints.title: An empty purse
hints.text: You can buy the shop of a merchant who has gone broke.

hints.title: Your own stall
hints.text: A shop owner can take its takings and set prices for each shelf.

hints.title: Trade by hand
hints.text: You can trade with another player hand to hand.

hints.title: Trade taxes
hints.text: Trades between two Lit are taxed more heavily than trades with the Dim.

hints.title: Fresh supplies
hints.text: Potions and supplies are sold in Sindr’s market square.

hints.title: Arms and armour
hints.text: Sindr’s market has a merchant for arms and armour.

hints.title: Raw materials
hints.text: Sindr’s market has a merchant for shards and materials.

hints.title: Earn and spend
hints.text: Spend CHROMA on supplies or save it for training.

hints.title: A red flag
hints.text: Robbing another player earns a red flag.

hints.title: Three flags
hints.text: Three red flags held at once become a bounty.

hints.title: Waiting out a flag
hints.text: Red flags fade with time, but a bounty stays.

hints.title: Pay the bounty
hints.text: A bounty ends when you pay it off or someone beats you and collects it.

hints.title: The cost of jail
hints.text: Jail takes 40% of your CHROMA, materials and gear, including the vault.

hints.title: The vault has limits
hints.text: Banking does not protect your savings from a jail seizure.

hints.title: A fine on top
hints.text: Getting out of jail costs a fine as well as the seizure.

hints.title: Land stays yours
hints.text: Jail does not seize land.

hints.title: Potions in a fight
hints.text: Drinking a potion leaves you open to attack.

hints.title: Training
hints.text: To rise a fighting tier, qualify through fights, pay the master and win the trial.

hints.title: Permanent tiers
hints.text: Losing a fight does not lower your permanent tier.

hints.title: A fair stake
hints.text: An accepted duel risks only the stake both players agreed on.

hints.title: Fire and wind
hints.text: Wind can extinguish fire.

hints.title: Fire and water
hints.text: Water can extinguish fire.

hints.title: Incoming stone
hints.text: Wind and water can redirect flying boulders.

hints.title: A stone wall
hints.text: TERRA walls block elemental attacks while they stand.

hints.title: Water within reach
hints.text: AQUES needs water nearby to bend.

hints.title: Earth underfoot
hints.text: TERRA needs an earth surface underfoot; wooden floors cannot supply it.

hints.title: Fire anywhere
hints.text: IGNIS bends without needing an outside source.

hints.title: Air anywhere
hints.text: AURA bends without needing an outside source.

hints.title: Reusable water
hints.text: Water attacks leave splash pools that can be used again.

hints.title: Water quality
hints.text: Wellspring water heals more strongly than water from a waterskin.

hints.title: Internal scars
hints.text: Water healing cannot cure deep internal scars.

hints.title: Keep the blade
hints.text: IGNIS can keep a weapon in hand while bending.

hints.title: Free hands
hints.text: AQUES and TERRA put weapons away to bend.

hints.title: AURA weapons
hints.text: AURA can bend with a staff, war fans or a glider in hand.

hints.title: Close range
hints.text: Hands and legs fight faster and closer than weapons, with shorter reach.

hints.title: Bending freely
hints.text: Bending combos spend the combo meter, while ordinary bending does not run out.

hints.title: Build a combo
hints.text: Landing hits fills the combo meter.

hints.title: No fixed cycle
hints.text: Elemental advantages depend on terrain, weather and the move used.

hints.title: Choose when to bend
hints.text: A Shaper can fight without bending to pass unnoticed as one of the Dim.

hints.title: The ultimate tier
hints.text: Each element’s signature ultimate opens at tier five.
